hook.name: SentryStockFeeHookV3
hook.description: Launch hook with a time-decaying dynamic fee (high start → floor) that skims fees from swaps and splits them among creator, treasury, holder reflections (via dividend token notifyReward), and auto-compounding locked full-range LP. A pre-reflection delay window redirects the reflection share to creator/treasury; whitelisted launch wallets pay the floor fee rate.
